_README: Per-file counts of INLINE student text, ratcheted: they may fall and may not rise. All of these fell to 0 when the scrub replaced quoted sentences with {{corpus:...}} references; measured on disk in BOTH the dry-run and live trees on 2026-09-24, with the classifier positive-controlled against a real student span first. A zero is not a formality: precommit_gate refuses any staged file whose count exceeds its entry, and an ABSENT entry is also 0, so this file now permits nothing anywhere. Listed explicitly rather than left as {} so that the ratchet reads as enforced rather than abandoned. EXEMPTIONS DO NOT GO HERE -- see NOT_STUDENT_TEXT and ACCEPTED_STUDENT_TEXT in precommit_gate.py. Two entries were dropped on the same date because the files no longer exist in either tree: scoring/BACKLOG.md (3) and scoring/rubric_h2.py (1); listing a file that is gone implies it is being watched. NEVER DELETE THIS FILE: _student_text_gate returns 0 on FileNotFoundError, so a missing budget disables the gate silently.
